feat(models): guided setup wizard with vendor/custom/subscription channels

Replaces the flat model-creation form with a two-step wizard (pick a
channel, then fill credentials and save/test) covering API-key vendors,
custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and the local ChatGPT/Codex
subscription. Auto-fetches each provider's live model catalog (newest
first, non-chat models filtered) instead of showing hardcoded guesses,
and splits save from test so a draft can be persisted without forcing
an immediate verification call.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(models): address CodeRabbit review findings on PR #14

- Follow Gemini's models.list nextPageToken pagination instead of
  silently dropping every model past the first page.
- Reject a syntactically-valid but non-object extra_body (array,
  string, number) instead of discarding it into {} without telling
  the user their input was ignored.
- Track the combobox's typed query separately from the committed
  value, so reopening the model dropdown after a selection shows the
  full catalog again instead of just the one already-picked match.
- Reject a blank Temperature/Max Tokens field before Number()
  converts it to 0 and the backend silently accepts a nonsensical
  value, in both the wizard's custom-channel form and the edit dialog.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(models): clear stale custom-channel model list on protocol switch

Changing the custom channel's API protocol dropdown left the model
list (and its selected value) fetched under the old protocol still
selectable, letting a model id that was never valid for the newly
picked protocol get saved. Clear the fetch state on protocol change
and immediately re-fetch under the new one.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(models): clear the picked model too on custom-channel protocol switch

The previous fix cleared the fetched model list on protocol change but
left customForm.model itself untouched, so an already-picked model id
from the old protocol could still be saved under the new one.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

## ⚠️ Depends on #241

This PR is stacked on top of #241 (feat(models): add ChatGPT subscription authentication via local Codex), which is not yet merged. It uses the `codex_subscription` module #241 introduces.

The diff below currently includes #241's commits too, since this branch is built on top of it. Once #241 merges, this diff will automatically shrink to just this PR's own changes. **Please review/merge #241 first.**

## Summary
- Replaces the flat model-creation form with a two-step guided wizard: pick a channel (vendor API key / custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint / ChatGPT-Codex subscription) first, then fill credentials and save/test.
- Model lists are fetched live from each provider (no hardcoded fallback candidates on fetch failure), sorted newest-first for OpenAI/Anthropic with non-chat models filtered out, and Gemini's paginated catalog is followed to the end instead of only returning the first page.
- "保存" (draft, unverified) and "测试" (verify + activate) are separate actions instead of one combined button; testing without a model selected is disallowed.
- Fixes a duplicate dialog close button, a stale test-result banner leaking across channel switches, a config-name field that leaked across channel switches, a "默认模型" stat-card overflow bug (long names now truncate with a tooltip), and clears a stale model list/selection when the custom channel's API protocol is changed. Config name is capped at 30 characters with a live limit-reached hint.
